results.title: Meet Eknath Vasant Chitnis: The man who helped build ISRO, recognized the potential of a young APJ Abdul Kalam and brought satellite TV to Indian villages
results.description: Professor Eknath Vasant Chitnis played a pivotal role in pioneering India’s initial forays into space research. Collaborating closely with Vikram Sarabhai, he was integral in laying the groundwork for the nation’s space program. Notably, he chose Thumba for India’s first rocket launches and astutely recognized APJ Abdul Kalam’s talent, inviting him to join ISRO. His efforts contributed significantly to expanding satellite television access to isolated communities across India.

Sunderland Boss Le Bris: Arsenal Are Europe’s Best Team
results.description: Black Cats manager impressed by Gunners’ form ahead of Premier League clash Sunderland manager Régis Le Bris has described Arsenal as the best team in Europe, praising Mikel Arteta’s side for their outstanding run of form ahead of their Premier League meeting on Saturday night. Le Bris made the assessment during his pre-match press conference as Sunderland prepare to face an Arsenal side he believes are currently playing at an exceptional level. The Sunderland boss pointed to Arsenal’s recent performances, including their display against Napoli, as evidence of the quality and consistency the London club have shown. “I think they [Arsenal] are in great form right now. They are currently the best team in Europe,” Le Bris said of Arsenal. The French manager also highlighted Arsenal’s winning run, describing the momentum generated by Arteta’s men as remarkable. “For example, their performance [against Napoli] was impressive. It seems they have achieved five consecutive wins, and this momentum is truly remarkable,” he added. Le Bris’ comments underline the scale of the challenge awaiting Sunderland, who will have to contend with an Arsenal side enjoying a strong spell of results. Arsenal have developed into one of the leading forces in European football under Arteta, with the manager building a team noted for its tactical organisation, defensive solidity and attacking quality. For Sunderland, Saturday’s encounter presents an opportunity to measure themselves against one of the Premier League’s leading sides. Le Bris will hope his players can match Arsenal’s intensity and disrupt the visitors’ momentum. The fixture is expected to provide another stern test for Sunderland as they continue their Premier League campaign, while Arsenal will be looking to maintain their impressive run and strengthen their position among the competition’s leading teams.

results.title: PM Modi holds talks with Malaysian counterpart
results.description: New Delhi, Sep 12: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday held talks with his Malaysian counterpart Anwar Ibrahim, focusing on boosting bilateral cooperation in sectors such as energy, defence, trade and investment. Anwar is in New Delhi to attend the BRICS summit. "Building on Prime Minister Modi's visit to Malaysia in February 2026, the leaders reviewed the progress in bilateral cooperation across a range of areas, including trade and investment, defence and security, semiconductors, infrastructure, digital economy, energy, fintech, education, tourism and people-to-people ties," External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said on social media. The leaders exchanged views on key regional and global issues of mutual interest, he said.
